tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search products across the global multi-store catalog.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve details for a specific product: specs, variants, availability.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Resolve multiple product or variant identifiers in one call.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search FAQ content for a specific store.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Retrieve a formal policy document for a specific store.

tools.name: list_policies
tools.description: List the policies available for a specific store.

tools.name: get_ui_state
tools.description: Current Commerce Layer state: what the buyer sees on screen right now.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create a new cart with line items; returns cart ID, totals, continue_url.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieve the current full state of an existing cart.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Replace the full state of an existing cart (PUT semantics).

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Permanently cancel an existing cart. Destructive.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an original image from a text prompt; returns a public image URL.
